title: Secret ingredient
description: A gold foil seal peels across a moving crease to reveal the basil beneath.
useCase: Make a deliberate ingredient, offer or membership reveal feel tactile without obscuring the revealed content.
interaction: Peel the foil, then press either the foil reverse or exposed seal area to reseal.
reducedMotion: The seal changes state immediately for keyboard and reduced motion. Host pause freezes an in-progress fold and resumes its existing target when reactivated.
limitations: A bounded SVG fold with a rigid mirrored reverse and authored lighting; not a soft-body paper simulation. All packaging and ingredient artwork is original fictional content.
look: Sage-green packet with a dark green serif wordmark and a round metallic gold foil seal bearing an italic monogram, on a pale sage background.
motion: Clicking sweeps a vertical crease right to left across the seal over 560 ms (cubic ease-out), folding back a mirrored pale reverse to uncover the ingredient; clicking again reseals.
adapt: A `requestAnimationFrame` tween in the effect drives `progress`, and `fold` maps it to the crease position used by the clip rects, mirrored reverse and crease gradient. Tune `duration` there; replace the packet copy, `ps-ingredient` artwork and the seal monogram.
